text:
Marie: Quick heads up — I'm planning a small rollout this week: an API-key shim that rewrites legacy project keys to an org-backed identity so we can centralize quotas and telemetry. Wanted to surface UX worries before we flip.
Sam: Can you sketch the mapping? is it a header rewrite, token exchange, or passthrough?
Marie: It's a lightweight rewrite at the gateway. If key matches legacy-project pattern we add X-Effective-Owner: org:1234 and route quota checks to org bucket. No exchange call.
Devin: Won't that break customers who depend on project-level billing/visibility?
Marie: Good call. Plan is opt-in at first: flag per-tenant, only for customers who agreed in the console. We'll also keep a console toggle to view "original key owner" vs "effective owner".
Lucy: For telemetry: please keep both tags. We need original_project and effective_owner in traces to attribute regressions. Otherwise cost dashboards will be wrong.
Marie: Yep — tracing will emit both. Example log line we intend: 
```
INFO gateway request key=proj_abc123 original_project=proj:abc123 effective_owner=org:1234 route=org-quota
```
Sam: How do we show this in the console? Small text under API keys? Maybe a banner: "This key is currently routed to org quotas" and a link to revert.
Marie: Exactly. UX idea: on the key detail page show a pill: [Routing: Org quota] with a tooltip and an undo button. For bulk keys we'll add a batch revert.
Paul: Edge case: what about revoked keys? If a project key is revoked but org still owns things, we should not silently rebind. Need a check: only shim when key is active and not listed in revocation list.
Devin: Also watch for rate-limit double-counting during canary. If we flip some traffic to org quotas and others still hit project quotas we could hit both and confuse customers. Need a circuit-breaker and a migration window where we mirror counts but bill only one side.
Marie: Agreed. Canary plan: 1) enable shim flagged for a customer but mirror counts for 48h; 2) expose discrepancy report in console; 3) after manual signoff we switch enforcement.
Lucy: Telemetry note: include sampling uniformity across routing variants so A/B comparison is reliable. Add a tag route_variant=shim|direct.
Sam: Implementation nit: keep the shim idempotent — token that already has X-Effective-Owner should be a no-op. Also include a header X-Shim-Version to help debug.
Marie: Good. I'll add X-Shim-Version and route_variant.
ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled: canary on gateway cluster alpha-2 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z. Monitor: gateway-reqs, org-quota-errors, billing-discrepancy-alert.
Paul: Who's owning the console copy? I can add the tooltip and revert flow if someone files a tiny spec.
Marie: Thanks Paul — will drop a short spec in #eng-platform-docs by EOD.
Sam: One more: audit logs. Every automatic rebind must create an audit entry tied to the key id and who approved (system or console opt-in).
Marie: Logged. We'll emit audit.events: {action: "shim_bind", key: "proj_...", actor: "system", reason: "org-mapping"} (structured event).
Lucy: +1. Also add an eval to the quality dashboard so any generation quality shifts correlated with routing are surfaced.
Marie: I'll add eval hooks. Thanks all — will post the tiny spec and the canary checklist shortly. :thumbsup:
Sam: lgtm — keep us posted, happy to help with monitoring alerts.
Devin: I'll review the spec for billing edge cases once it's up.
Marie: Appreciate it.
